title: Grampians Peaks Trail — plan and prepare guide (Parks Victoria)
claims: Halls Gap is a 3-hour (255 km) drive from Melbourne and a 5.5-hour (500 km) drive from Adelaide; Dunkeld is a 3-hour (270 km) drive from Melbourne.
Public Transport Victoria operates rail services to Ararat, and Horsham and Stawell are stops on The Overland train between Melbourne and Adelaide.
Tullamarine International Airport (Melbourne) and Avalon Airport are the nearest airports.
Some Grampians trailheads have very limited or no parking, and Parks Victoria recommends drop-off and pick-up with a Licensed Tour Operator there.
